title: Minecraft waypoint style definition
description: Defines distance thresholds and sprite lists for locator bar waypoints.

near_distance.title: Near distance threshold
near_distance.description: The maximum distance at which the first sprite in sprites is used. Defaults to 128.

far_distance.title: Far distance threshold
far_distance.description: The minimum distance at which the last sprite in sprites is used. Defaults to 332. Value should be greater than near_distance.

sprites.title: Sprites
sprites.description: Locator bar dot sprite paths. Resolves to textures/gui/sprites/hud/locator_bar_dot.
